audit.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, shlex, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path(".").resolve()
canonical_path = root / "docs/evidence/2026-09-10-v1-05c2d4-bounded-executor-supervision.json"
report = json.loads(canonical_path.read_bytes())
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
for entry in [report["root_validation"], report["inventory"], *report["references"]]:
    assert sha((root / entry["path"]).read_bytes()) == entry["sha256"], entry["path"]
inventory = json.loads((root / report["inventory"]["path"]).read_bytes())
assert inventory["pre_post_equal"] is True
assert inventory["counts"] == {"core": 622, "pro": 214, "total": 836}
for repo, directory, commit in [("core", root, report["code_commit"]),
        ("pro", root.parent / "orze-pro", report["baseline_pro"])]:
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(directory), "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", commit, "HEAD"], check=True)
    assert len(inventory["files"][repo]) == inventory["counts"][repo]
    for entry in inventory["files"][repo]:
        assert sha((directory / entry["path"]).read_bytes()) == entry["sha256"], entry["path"]
        raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(directory), "show", commit + ":" + entry["path"]])
        assert sha(raw) == entry["sha256"], (repo, entry["path"])
validation = json.loads((root / report["root_validation"]["path"]).read_bytes())
checked = subprocess.run(validation["static_audit_command"], shell=True, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
assert json.loads(checked.stdout) == validation["static_audit"]
support = subprocess.run(validation["supporting_audit_command"], shell=True, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
assert json.loads(support.stdout) == validation["supporting_audit"]
assert validation["verification"] == report["verification"]
assert report["case_classification"]["new_cases_total"] == 63
assert sum(report["case_classification"][key] for key in ("previous_commit_behavior_red", "previous_commit_controls", "new_requirements_and_mechanisms", "draft_behavior_red")) == 63
assert report["whole_v1_complete"] is False
commands = bodies = 0
def walk(value):
    global commands, bodies
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            if isinstance(child, str) and (key == "command" or key.endswith("_command")):
                commands += 1
                subprocess.run(["bash", "-n"], input=child, text=True, check=True, capture_output=True)
                if "<<'PY'" in child:
                    ast.parse(child.split("\n", 1)[1].rsplit("\nPY", 1)[0])
                    bodies += 1
                else:
                    words = shlex.split(child)
                    for i, word in enumerate(words):
                        if word == "-c" and i and words[i-1] in ("python", "python3"):
                            ast.parse(words[i+1])
                            bodies += 1
            walk(child)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            walk(child)
for document in [report, validation, inventory, *[json.loads((root / entry["path"]).read_bytes()) for entry in report["references"] if entry["path"].endswith(".json")]]:
    walk(document)
print(json.dumps({"status": "passed", "source_test_build_files": 836,
    "worktree_and_fixed_commit_hashes_exact": True, "snapshots": 7,
    "fixed_baseline_byte_equal": 4, "new_tests": 63, "assert_nodes": 181,
    "command_occurrences": commands, "python_bodies": bodies}, sort_keys=True))
